basic_info.description: Rarely available corner unit in historic downtown building.  Built near the turn of the century as an ice house, 16 Jessie (also known as 1 Ecker) was recreated in 2010 to bring out the character of a refined warehouse home. Original details and modern architecture highlight this this one-of-a-kind brick & steel historic loft/condominium in the Financial District. This home offers an open floor plan w 2 separated bedrooms, 2 full baths, open living/dining area, extensive exposed brick, soaring 11+' ceilings, arched windows, modern finishes and more. Cesarstone kitchen countertops, high end appliances, Bertazzoni convection cooktop stove & oven (don't worry gas is plumbed as well), Fisher & Paykel refrigerator, Miele DW, & bamboo flooring throughout. Storage, bike storage, Google ethernet service & a stunning rooftop lounge (with barbecue area) are offered as well. This is the perfect urban oasis for those seeking NYC vibes, walkability, and tranquility. HOA fee includes water, internet (Google Fiber), trash/recycling, entry & safety systems, exterior window washing, maintenance of all common areas (including roof deck and grills) plus all the other usual things funded by reserve and operating budgets.
